summary:
Airwallex is reached through a single Node REST client, src/airwallex/client.ts, which only talks to the sandbox. A per-run call budget and call log wrap it, both set by env (AIRWALLEX_CALL_BUDGET, AIRWALLEX_CALL_LOG). Ports for the rails are src/airwallex/port.ts and src/airwallex/issuing.ts, with fakes in src/redteam/airwallex.ts and src/redteam/issuing.ts.

What has run live in the sandbox: FX, transfers, the transfer simulation, card limits and controls, an agent card declined over its limit with a Face ID raise synced to the card (on 29 Oct and again in awx-1 on 7 Nov), payment acceptance, and connected accounts with an application fee (taken on 10 Nov). The two-locks transfer 4074d684-4704-406c-a527-2832753baf4f (P261110-48HWOJN) is still IN_APPROVAL after 7 of the 10 approved calls. To finish it, `follow` and `settle` need 5 calls, because each process logs in again; the record's "3 are kept" is wrong.

The run's ledger is not in the keys repo. Its folder x402-business-agents-keys/two-locks is empty; the ledger and call log are /home/user/x402-business-agents/data/two-locks.sqlite and /home/user/x402-business-agents/data/two-locks-calls.jsonl. The primary checkout is on branch invoice-inbox, which has no twoLocks.ts.

The Airi/VIC run (vic-1) passed on 7 Nov at the fourth attempt. Its fixes are in main: camelCase output parsed, the hosted checkout instead of the API confirm, a unique order reference, and a labelled tap line with a reminder every minute. Nothing for a series exists yet: no driver, and the Airi rules are sourcing-only. In a Worker, only the plain-fetch parts work: login, read-only calls such as the FX quote, and webhook HMAC checks.

key_files.role: Sandbox REST client (class Airwallex, fromEnv, SANDBOX_BASE). Login with x-client-id/x-api-key gives a 30-min bearer token, refreshed 5 min early. One queue at 5 calls/s; 429 backoff; reads retried on 502/503/504; a POST without an answer throws AirwallexAmbiguous; the base URL must be api.sandbox.airwallex.com. redact().

Call budget: budgetFromEnv reads AIRWALLEX_CALL_BUDGET + AIRWALLEX_CALL_LOG (both or neither). budgetedFetch appends one JSONL line {at,method,endpoint,pid} per request before sending (logins and retries count, across processes). AirwallexBudgetSpent, readCallLog, countByEndpoint, endpointOf (on main its id regex folds 'payment_intents' to {id}; fixed on platform).

AirwallexRail (balances, deposits, FX rate/quote/conversion, beneficiaries, transfers, findTransferByRequestIdStrict) and SandboxSim (simulateDeposit, transitionTransfer). TransferStatus includes IN_APPROVAL, APPROVAL_*.
AirwallexRest, airwallexFromEnv() (makes no calls at start). Sim endpoints: POST /simulation/deposit/create, POST /simulation/transfers/{id}/transition.
Second lock: followTransfer (GET only; records the status and raises an alarm if the amount or payee changed), describeTransferStatus, inAirwallexApproval, APPROVAL_STATES.

IssuingRail/IssuingSim, IssuingRest: cardholders, cards create/get, setCardLimits/setCardControls/setCardStatus (POST /issuing/cards/{id}/update), listCardTransactions, simulateCardCharge (POST /simulation/issuing/create), issuingFromEnv. On platform: CardAccountGuard/binding check.
Payment acceptance: POST /pa/payment_intents/create, /{id}/confirm, GET /{id}.
GET /webhooks, POST /webhooks/create (npm run cards -- webhook).
FakeAirwallex stand-in: approvalWorkflow flag, decideInWebApp(), loseNextTransferAnswer, SANDBOX_SWIFT_FEE_CENTS=1340. Platform version adds requirePayerRegistration.

npm run two-locks -- stand-in|create|follow|settle|facts. Live needs TWO_LOCKS_GO=yes, AIRWALLEX_CALL_BUDGET, AIRWALLEX_CALL_LOG and KIT11_DB matching /two-locks[^/]*\.sqlite$/. settle refuses unless the ledger status is SCHEDULED, PROCESSING or SENT.
Two-locks record. Must be rewritten after the approval: the 'Not completed' row, the summary paragraph and the Calls section.
The two-locks run's ledger (not in the keys repo; x402-business-agents-keys/two-locks is empty). Call log: /home/user/x402-business-agents/data/two-locks-calls.jsonl (7 lines).
npm run cards -- setup|sync|poll|buy <plan>|raise <agent> <per purchase> [<per month>] [--reason]|scenario|webhook. PLANS are in src/config/policy.ts (packwise-starter 19.99, packwise-pro 45.00, …).
npm run awx-1 -- plan|stand-in|preflight|live [--from step]|record. Steps (src/awx/scenario.ts STEPS): a,b,c,d,f1,f2,close. There is no --to, so it always runs through the payouts.

AiriCliClient: runs the pinned airi-cli 0.1.0-beta.4 Go binary (DEFAULT_AIRI_CLI=/opt/node22/bin/airi-cli; PINNED_BINARY_SHA256 linux-x64) with execFile, -o json --no-telemetry and a bare env; accepts camelCase or snake_case; TAP_WAIT_S=300.
liveAiriDeps, checkoutFromEnv (AIRI_CHECKOUT=hosted default | api), tap-link sinks (console or the 0600 file airi-tap-link.json in the keys dir), awaitWithTap, TAP_WINDOW_MS=5 min.

The Airi purchase flow (alone vs CFO route, proposal, mandate, credential, checkout, result). orderRef = `${action_id}-${created_at base36}` (the duplicate_request fix). The mandate description holds [actionId], not the terms hash.
AirwallexHostedCheckout: PaymentIntent plus the Hosted Payment Page, filled in headless Chromium on checkout.sandbox.airwallex.com.
vic-1 conductor: preflight (whoami with SESSION_MARGIN_MS=10 min, payment-methods list), purchases A/B/C. agent is hard-coded to 'sourcing'.
Airi rail rules (airiRuleDefs): ALONE_KEY default 20.00 EUR, PER_DAY default 3 (choices 0-10), AIRI_HARD_CAP_CENTS=20000. Both rules are agent:'sourcing' only.

npm run airi:vic-1 -- --dry|preflight|live|recover. Live needs KIT11_AIRI_RAIL=on, KIT11_DB=…vic-1*.sqlite, KIT11_KEYS_DIR=…/vic-1*, METAL_RPC_URL unset, the Airwallex keys + budget/log, VIC1_GO=yes, and VIC1_AIRI_CALL_BUDGET (default 12).
TWO_LOCKS_LINE (line 171) rendered on /airwallex.
/runs rows. two-locks-1 stats on line 70; what/checks/ids on lines 82-87. docs/runs/README.md is generated from it by npx tsx src/cli/runs-readme.ts.
Deck TWO_LOCKS_LINE (line 45). npm run submission rebuilds docs/submission/purser-deck.pdf.
Form text: line 72 'After the kit…IN_APPROVAL, unpaid'; notes on lines 47-48; 'Characters: **3,970**' on line 28 must match the real count.

AirwallexPlatformRest (createConnectedAccount, onboardingLink, getAccount, findConnectedAccount), ACCOUNT_ID, platformOn (AIRWALLEX_PLATFORM=on), platformFeeOn (AIRWALLEX_PLATFORM_FEE=on). Platform client.ts adds onBehalfOf (AIRWALLEX_ON_BEHALF_OF) → x-on-behalf-of header.

soleTraderDetails() (SOLE_PROPRIETOR, no business_identifiers: the cause of the payout refusals) and LivePlatformOps.ensureAccount (create → update → submit → wait 60 s → simulation update_status ACTIVE).
WORLD: SANDBOXTEST (acct_SC-QD89fOneAeqaRFgOymw), BAKKERIJ and FIETSLAB (accountId null, testRegistrationNumber TEST-0000000x), with their invoices.

npm run e2e:live [-- --live] (platform only). Env: E2E_LIVE=yes, E2E_BUDGET="airwallex=…,t0=…,claude=…", E2E_T0_CURRENCY, T0_RATES; retry path reads AIRWALLEX_PLATFORM, AIRWALLEX_PLATFORM_FEE, PURSER_PLATFORM_PUBLIC_KEY, PURSER_TENANT_ID.
The only Worker code that calls Airwallex. AWX_ALLOWED allows only POST /api/v1/authentication/login and POST /api/v1/fx/quotes/create, by fetch.

how_it_works:
Every Airwallex call goes Airwallex.call → enqueue (200 ms gap) → bearer() (cached login) → fetch. When a budget is set, fetch is budgetedFetch: it appends a log line and refuses at the budget before sending. Each process logs in once, so each separate CLI command costs at least one extra call.

Rails are interfaces (AirwallexRail, SandboxSim, IssuingRail, IssuingSim). Live code uses AirwallexRest and IssuingRest; tests, the red team and stand-ins use FakeAirwallex and the fake issuing rail. A payout is created only after a passkey assertion over terms_sha256; executeInvoicePayment sends POST /transfers/create with metadata.approval_sha256.

With Airwallex's approval workflow on, the transfer comes back IN_APPROVAL. followTransfer only reads it back. After a person approves in the web app it becomes SCHEDULED, and the sandbox needs POST /simulation/transfers/{id}/transition to reach SENT and then PAID.

Airi: the CFO policy decides alone vs CFO. An above-limit purchase becomes a proposal and needs Face ID on the relay. Then airi-cli runs mandate create (giving a one-time passkey URL shown to the owner), mandate get-credential (waits up to 300 s for the tap), the hosted checkout (PaymentIntent create, card filled by headless Chromium, GET for the outcome), and mandate result.

answers.question: 1) Airwallex adapter/port files, auth, call budget and call log (env names), sandbox simulation endpoints
answers.answer:
Files: src/airwallex/{client.ts (Airwallex, fromEnv, AirwallexError, AirwallexAmbiguous, redact), port.ts (AirwallexRail, SandboxSim), adapter.ts (AirwallexRest, airwallexFromEnv), issuing.ts (IssuingRest, issuingFromEnv), cardBody.ts, acceptance.ts, approvals.ts, verify.ts, webhooks.ts, callBudget.ts}. Platform adds platform.ts, binding.ts and bankNames.ts.

Auth: POST /authentication/login with headers x-client-id and x-api-key. Env: AIRWALLEX_CLIENT_ID, AIRWALLEX_API_KEY. The token lasts 30 min and is refreshed 5 min early; one 401 retry. Platform only: AIRWALLEX_PLATFORM=on plus AIRWALLEX_ON_BEHALF_OF=acct_… adds the x-on-behalf-of header.

Budget: AIRWALLEX_CALL_BUDGET (a whole number) and AIRWALLEX_CALL_LOG (a file path), both or neither. Every HTTP request (logins and retries too) is appended as {at,method,endpoint,pid} JSONL before it is sent, shared across processes. The request that would go over the budget throws AirwallexBudgetSpent and is not sent.

Sandbox simulation endpoints: POST /simulation/deposit/create; POST /simulation/transfers/{id}/transition {next_status: SENT|PAID|FAILED}; POST /simulation/issuing/create (merchant charge); platform only: POST /simulation/accounts/{id}/update_status {next_status: ACTIVE} (works only after SUBMITTED, about 60 s after submit).

answers.answer:

- Approvals: IN_APPROVAL on create and on read-back is live (two-locks 4074d684…). The web-app approval and the step from SCHEDULED to PAID after an approval have run only on FakeAirwallex (approvalWorkflow, decideInWebApp).
- Payment acceptance: create/confirm/GET live (int_sgpv9bnppho0sezgl4a SUCCEEDED, 10 Nov). Webhook, declines and settlement: tests only.
- Issuing, one card per agent: live on 29 Oct (cards.md) and in awx-1 (7 Nov): 3 cards with limits/MCC/currency controls; LIMIT_EXCEEDED and MERCHANT_CATEGORY_NOT_ALLOWED declines; Face ID raise → POST /issuing/cards/{id}/update → the same charge approved; webhooks via the relay.

FAKE ONLY: the Airwallex approval decision and its aftermath; AirwallexAmbiguous / lost transfer answers; Airwallex's payer-registration refusal (requirePayerRegistration, platform fake, modelled after the live refusal); everything after ACTIVE for accounts opened as registered sole traders (unknown live).

answers.question: 3) Two locks: exact remaining steps after approval of P261110-48HWOJN
answers.answer:
State: transfer 4074d684-4704-406c-a527-2832753baf4f, EUR 240.00, IN_APPROVAL, funding REQUIRES_FUNDING_CONFIRMATION. Used: 7 of 10 calls (2 logins, 3 GET /balances/current, 1 POST /transfers/create, 1 GET /transfers/{id}).

Where the ledger is: NOT in the keys repo. /home/user/x402-business-agents-keys/two-locks exists but is empty. Ledger: /home/user/x402-business-agents/data/two-locks.sqlite. Call log: /home/user/x402-business-agents/data/two-locks-calls.jsonl.

Calls needed: follow = login + GET /transfers/{id} = 2. settle = login + 2 × POST /simulation/transfers/{id}/transition = 3 (2 if already SENT). Total 5, so AIRWALLEX_CALL_BUDGET must be at least 12 (14 if you want a final read-back with follow). The record's '3 are kept' and the plan's 'precies 3 calls' (keys plans/2026-11-11/purser-masterlijst.md line 567) are wrong.

Run from a main checkout with node_modules. The primary checkout /home/user/x402-business-agents is on branch invoice-inbox, which has no src/cli/twoLocks.ts.
Commands (with AIRWALLEX_CLIENT_ID and AIRWALLEX_API_KEY set):

answers.question: 4) Issuing live run: card per agent, decline over limit, Face ID raise, sync, success
answers.answer:
This has already run live twice. 29 Oct (docs/runs/2026-10-29-cards.md): P-0010 by Face ID, 30→50, the 45.00 EUR Pro plan approved. 7 Nov awx-1 steps a–c (docs/runs/2026-11-07-awx-1.md): cards ····2441/····4175/····1562; 45.00 declined LIMIT_EXCEEDED; Claude Haiku proposed P-0001; Max's Face ID; card.limits_synced 30.00→45.00; approved 2.0 s later.

Code: src/airwallex/issuing.ts (IssuingRest.setCardLimits → POST /issuing/cards/{id}/update, then a read-back), cardBody.ts, src/cli/cards.ts, src/awx/scenario.ts (runAwx1), and the runner/relay that executes the policy_change after Face ID.

Ways to rerun:
(a) npm run awx-1 -- preflight, then AWX1_GO=yes npm run awx-1 -- live. This runs a→close, including 2 payouts, 3 Face IDs, about 85 calls (budget 96 in awx-1); there is no --to option (code change needed for a card-only run).
(b) Manual: npm run cards -- setup; npm run cards -- buy packwise-starter; npm run cards -- buy packwise-pro (declined); npm run cards -- raise sourcing 45.00 --reason "…"; Face ID; the runner syncs; npm run cards -- buy packwise-pro.

Runner: npm run relay -- --enrol with the same env (KIT11_DB, KIT11_KEYS_DIR, KIT11_AGENTS=on for the Claude proposal, KIT11_CARD_POLL_MS=off for webhooks only, AIRWALLEX_CALL_BUDGET, AIRWALLEX_CALL_LOG). Webhooks need AIRWALLEX_WEBHOOK_SECRET on the Worker (npm run cards -- webhook).

Calls for a card-only run: roughly 25 (estimate from the awx-1 table: login ~3, cardholders 3, cards list 4, create 3, get ~5, simulation 3, update 1, transactions ~3); exact count unknown.

Owner: enrol the passkey (Face ID, then confirm the fingerprint), then one Face ID on the raise. About 6 minutes of scenario.

answers.question: 5) Payouts for several companies via connected accounts
answers.answer:
Exists only on the platform branch:
- src/airwallex/platform.ts: AirwallexPlatformRest.createConnectedAccount/getAccount/onboardingLink/findConnectedAccount.
- client onBehalfOf / x-on-behalf-of; port ApplicationFee → application_fee_options {source_type TRANSFER, type FIXED}.
- src/e2e/* plus the CLI npm run e2e:live [-- --live] (E2E_LIVE=yes, E2E_BUDGET); cloud/src/awxPlatform.ts (opening accounts, onboarding link, account.* webhooks, signed binding).

Records: docs/runs/2026-11-10-connected-accounts-sandbox.md (17 calls; one account ACTIVE; EUR 5.00 payout PAID with a EUR 0.05 fee). platform/docs/runs/2026-11-10-platform-e2e.md (75 of 81 calls; 3 companies; 1 PAID).

Why refused: BAKKERIJ (acct_O07lI0VvMLagXlj5aeOgyg) and FIETSLAB (acct_XFhJLpkwNp6lzl8rpySE_Q) were opened by soleTraderDetails() in src/e2e/platformOps.ts as SOLE_PROPRIETOR with no business_identifiers. POST /transfers/create then gave 400 validation_failed on payer.additional_info.business_registration_number. Adding a payer object with TEST-00000001 was refused too (field payer, code 048). SANDBOXTEST paid without one.

Fix the test data: open the companies as registered businesses with account_details.business_details.business_identifiers (for example an NL KvK number in the format Airwallex's NL KYC page asks for). That needs a variant of soleTraderDetails() and new accounts (accountId null in src/e2e/world.ts). Drop testRegistrationNumber and the payer object on transfers. The exact identifier type and format Airwallex accepts in the sandbox is unknown, and so is whether documents are then required.

Also open: Purser's fee on a payout refused at create stays DUE and should be voided.

answers.question: 6) Airi / VIC
answers.answer:
Flow (src/airi/*):
- policy.ts: rules for acting alone up to EUR 20.00 and 3 per day, sourcing only.
- purchase.ts: alone vs CFO proposal (airi_purchase, Face ID on the relay); mandate create (passkeyUrl) → get-credential (waits 300 s for the tap) → hostedCheckout.ts (PaymentIntent create, Hosted Payment Page filled by headless Chromium, GET for the outcome) → mandate result. cancelMandate if there is no tap.
- vic1.ts / src/cli/airiVic1.ts: the conductor. vic2.ts: Purser's checks around it, 0 calls.

Dependency: @airwallex/airi-cli 0.1.0-beta.4, installed at /opt/node22/bin/airi-cli. The Go binary in vendor/ is checked against PINNED_BINARY_SHA256 (linux-x64), or KIT11_AIRI_CLI and KIT11_AIRI_CLI_SHA256 for another binary. Install: AIRI_CLI_SKIP_SKILLS=1 AIRI_TELEMETRY_DISABLED=1 npm install -g @airwallex/airi-cli@0.1.0-beta.4. Playwright Chromium is needed for the hosted checkout.

Owner login: Claude runs airi-cli auth login --client-name "Purser". The owner opens https://app.airi.com/device on the phone, enters the code and approves. Claude runs airi-cli auth poll, then auth whoami -o json. The Airi test card 4111… must be added and switched to agent use in app.airi.com (already done on 7 Nov). The preflight stops if fewer than 10 min of session remain. The docs disagree on session length: about 1 hour (vic-1-plan) vs tokens that refresh and last 29 days (vic-airi.md README note).

Per run the owner does: enrol the world's passkey (Face ID, then read the fingerprint); tap A (open the one-time link, passkey in Airi, within 5 min); Face ID on B (P-000x 'Airi purchase' EUR 45.00); tap B (within 5 min). That is 3 actions per run plus enrolment.

Duration: the passing run took 13 min 20 s, mostly waiting (tap A 2 m 41 s, Face ID 5 m 8 s, tap B about 5 min). About 4 to 6 min if the owner is quick (estimate).

Failure modes of 7 Nov:
- camelCase output (mandateId/passkeyUrl): FIXED in 1b5cbd4 (cli.ts accepts both).
- confirm refused ('not enabled for native API access'): WORKED AROUND in b252cd3; AIRI_CHECKOUT=hosted is the default and api still fails.
- missed taps (link not labelled or not passed on; no tap in 5 min): MITIGATED (labelled 'AIRI TAP A/B' line, a notice every minute, tap-link file). There is still a hard 5-minute limit and it depends on a person.
- duplicate_request (request_id = bare P-0001 reused across worlds): FIXED in 2016aac (orderRef = action_id + created_at base36).
- enrolment window expiry: process only.

Series of 8-10 runs with a second agent needs new code:
- per-agent Airi rules (airiRuleDefs has agent:'sourcing' hard-coded);
- vic1.ts purchase agent parameter (line 91 'sourcing');
- a series driver and an aggregated record of the success rate for /visa.
None exists.

Per world: KIT11_DB=data/vic-1-sNN.sqlite, KIT11_KEYS_DIR=../x402-business-agents-keys/vic-1-sNN (both must match the vic-1* regex), KIT11_AIRI_RAIL=on, KIT11_CARD_POLL_MS=off, AIRI_CHECKOUT=hosted, AIRWALLEX_CLIENT_ID/AIRWALLEX_API_KEY, AIRWALLEX_CALL_BUDGET, AIRWALLEX_CALL_LOG, VIC1_AIRI_CALL_BUDGET (default 12), VIC1_GO=yes, optional AIRI_PAYMENT_METHOD_ID; METAL_RPC_URL, METAL_ENDPOINT_SECRET and T0_API_KEY unset.
Runner: npm run relay -- --enrol with the same env.

Calls per run: Airwallex 6 (2 logins, 2 PaymentIntent create, 2 GET), so about 60-70 for 10 runs; airi-cli about 9 (8 over the network); Claude 0.

Note: a reused world hits PER_DAY=3 for unattended purchases, so use a fresh world per run or raise the per-day limit with Face ID. The terms hash is not yet in the mandate description (masterlijst Visa item 5).

answers.question: 7) Owner step lists in plain words
answers.answer:
(a) Finish two locks (about 5 min, no Face ID):
1. On the laptop, open the Airwallex sandbox web app, go to Settings → Transfer approvals (or Transfers, pending approval), and find P261110-48HWOJN: EUR 240.00 to Stockline Data GmbH.
2. Click Approve. If it asks to confirm funding, confirm it.
3. Tell Claude 'approved' and allow 5 more Airwallex calls (12 in total).
4. Claude runs follow (should say 'scheduled'), then settle (sent, then paid). Check the reported status and say OK to update the record and the site.

(b) Airi series (about 15 min per run; 2 to 2.5 hours for 8-10 runs):
1. Approve the call numbers Claude proposes (about 6 Airwallex calls a run).
2. Log in to Airi: Claude shows a code. On the phone, open app.airi.com/device, type the code and approve. Repeat if Claude says the session is ending.
3. For each run:
   - Scan or open the enrolment link and use Face ID. Read the fingerprint back to Claude.
   - When Claude sends 'AIRI TAP A', open that link within 5 minutes and confirm with the passkey.
   - When the Purser approval for the EUR 45.00 purchase comes, check the amount and shop, then Face ID.
   - When 'AIRI TAP B' comes, open it within 5 minutes and confirm.
4. Keep the phone unlocked and near. Missing a 5-minute window fails that run.

(c) Card run (about 10 min):
1. Approve the call budget (about 25-35 Airwallex calls; awx-1-style about 96).
2. Enrol the passkey: open the link, Face ID, read the fingerprint back.
3. Watch the agent's card get declined at 45.00.
4. On the phone, open the raise request (30.00 → 45.00 per purchase) and approve with Face ID.
5. Claude shows the card limit read back from Airwallex and the same purchase approved.

answers.question: 8) Which Airwallex parts are usable from a Cloudflare Worker (fetch only)
answers.answer:
The API itself is plain HTTPS JSON (login headers, then a bearer token), so any call can be made with fetch.

Already in a Worker:
- main/worker/src/fxQuote.ts: login + POST /fx/quotes/create only, enforced by the AWX_ALLOWED allowlist; secrets AIRWALLEX_CLIENT_ID and AIRWALLEX_API_KEY.
- Webhook signature checks at /hooks/airwallex in the Relay Durable Object (AIRWALLEX_WEBHOOK_SECRET; HMAC with crypto.subtle).
- platform/cloud/src/awxPlatform.ts: account open, onboarding link and account.* webhooks. It imports only constants and types from src/airwallex/platform.ts and deliberately avoids the Node client.

Not usable as is:
- src/airwallex/client.ts: it imports callBudget.ts (node:fs appendFileSync/readFileSync) and fromEnv reads process.env. The main Worker has no nodejs_compat flag; cloud has nodejs_compat. The budget would need Durable Object storage instead of a file.
- adapter.ts, issuing.ts, acceptance.ts, webhooks.ts: fetch-only logic, but they import client.ts and node:crypto randomUUID (crypto.randomUUID is a global in Workers).
- approvals.ts and acceptance.ts: need the better-sqlite3 DB plus audit.
- The Airi rail: execFile of the Go airi-cli binary and a headless Chromium checkout. Not possible in a Worker.

A Worker-friendly path is a small fetch client with an endpoint allowlist, like fxQuote.ts, extended per endpoint (for example read-only GET /transfers/{id} or /issuing/cards/{id}) with a call counter in Durable Object storage.

pinned_by_tests.pins: TWO_LOCKS_LINE contains 'IN_APPROVAL; the web-app approval was not completed, so it is not paid'; the run record contains **`IN_APPROVAL`** and **Not completed.**; ids and EUR amounts in the line appear in the record.

The exact form sentence 'After the kit. Airwallex's own approval held a passkey-signed payout IN_APPROVAL, unpaid. Payables inbox: not public.'; the stated character count equals the real one, 3000 to 3999, and stays under 4000 with CRLF.
Row order of /runs (two-locks-1 first); docs/runs/README.md equals runsReadme().
TWO_LOCKS_LINE is excluded from the unknown-numbers check; its figures are checked through partner-pages.
IN_APPROVAL handling, describeTransferStatus('IN_APPROVAL')='waiting for Airwallex approval', followTransfer flags (behaviour; no change needed).

runtime_constraints: The client refuses any base URL other than https://api.sandbox.airwallex.com/.
Every separate CLI process logs in again: one extra call counted in the budget.
two-locks live needs TWO_LOCKS_GO=yes, a KIT11_DB ending in two-locks*.sqlite, and AIRWALLEX_CALL_BUDGET with AIRWALLEX_CALL_LOG.
vic-1 live needs KIT11_DB=*vic-1*.sqlite, KIT11_KEYS_DIR=*/vic-1*, KIT11_AIRI_RAIL=on, METAL_RPC_URL unset and VIC1_GO=yes.
Airi tap window is 5 minutes (TAP_WAIT_S=300); the preflight needs at least 10 minutes of Airi session left.
The primary checkout /home/user/x402-business-agents is on branch invoice-inbox, which has no twoLocks.ts; /home/user/ro/main has no node_modules.
Activating a connected account in the sandbox works about 60 s after submit, not immediately.
risks: The two-locks budget is under-planned: 3 calls are left but 5 are needed (2 logins). Get the owner's approval for at least 12 in total before running.
On 10 Nov the owner could not find the transfer in the web app; the funding status REQUIRES_FUNDING_CONFIRMATION may block approval (unknown).
The keys repo two-locks folder is empty; the ledger is only in /home/user/x402-business-agents/data and is not committed or backed up there.
The Airi series depends on many human taps (30-40) with 5-minute windows; Airi session expiry is uncertain.
Reusing one world for Airi runs hits the daily limit of 3 unattended purchases.
The form text count and several tests pin the 'not paid' wording; updating it touches about 10 files and needs a site redeploy and a deck/cheat-sheet PDF rebuild.
On main, the callBudget endpointOf regex folds 'payment_intents' into {id} (fixed on platform), so per-endpoint counts on main are misleading.
